baseline_models.mechanism: The line moves from edible output to a named producer qualified by protective envelopes, so present fruit and future fruit-in-formation coexist.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant fruit supplies the already edible yield in the production cycle.
The date-palm tree supplies the enduring producer beside its yield.
The plant envelope or fruit sheath makes the palm's covering a protective maturation chamber.

changed_reading.before: A flat inventory of fruit and date palms.
changed_reading.after: A compact production cycle: enjoyable yield is present while the palm carries later yield protected through development.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَٰكِهَةٌ beside a palm ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Experienced delight stands beside covered generativity; the earth contains both enjoyment available now and enjoyment held in reserve inside living envelopes.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant ease and delighted enjoyment broadens the fruit from an object into an experienced condition.
The protective plant envelope delays access and gives future delight a concealed material state.

changed_reading.before: Fruit denotes a consumable object already at hand.
changed_reading.after: Fruit names present delight, while the sheathed palm makes promised but not-yet-exposed delight part of the same provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence فَٰكِهَةٌ, نَّخْلُ, and أَكْمَامِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Form-distant palm branches activate sifting and choosing, while the sheath activates compact gathering; together they offer a process-image in which desired produce emerges through separation, concentration, and protection.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant produce supplies the valued output of the proposed filtering process.
Sifting flour supplies a separation mechanism without replacing the surface date-palm sense.
Choosing the best supplies the selective endpoint of the process-image.
A compact gathered mass supplies concentration inside the visible covering.

changed_reading.before: The palm is only one especially named species in the inventory.
changed_reading.after: The literal palm also carries an exploratory image of an apparatus that filters, gathers, and protects toward choice produce.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَٰكِهَةٌ joined to palm fruit still inside أَكْمَام
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of ف ك ه places rich nourishment before birth beside a botanical sheath, allowing a cautious analogy between fruit formation and provision generated before delivery.

activation_trace.role: Rich early milk before birthing supplies nourishment that appears while delivery is still pending.
The fruit sheath supplies temporary living enclosure around developing yield.

changed_reading.before: The verse presents only mature food and its tree.
changed_reading.after: It also permits a latent pre-birth model: nourishment is already being generated while the next yield remains enclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly supplies womb, gathered pregnancy, birth, nurture, hidden fetal life, and nearness of delivery. These turn the focus sheath into a temporary generative interior and the fruit into provision that passes from formation to availability.

activation_trace.role: Pre-birth rich milk anchors the focus itself in nourishment generated before delivery.
The protective plant sheath supplies the focus-side generative interior.
The womb branch introduces a bodily enclosure that generates and protects life.
A womb gathering a pregnancy supplies concentration of a future outcome inside a container.
Giving birth supplies the transition from enclosed load to delivered presence.
Nurture, repair, and completion supply the process that carries enclosed growth to readiness.
The fetus hidden in the belly reinforces protected life as a contextual enclosure image.
Nearness of parturition aligns the later near harvest with imminent emergence.

structural_cues: The packet opens with 55:1-4, places the earth in 55:10, and later locates near harvest in 55:54.
The focus grammatically binds the palm to sheaths with ذات, so enclosure is supplied by the ayah itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies womb, pregnancy-gathering, birth, nurture, hidden fetal life, and near parturition; I align those images with the sheath and infer a gestation-to-yield arrow. The live alternative is ordinary botanical development with no reproductive analogy.

changed_reading.before: Protected fruit development is only an agronomic detail.
changed_reading.after: Protected fruit development becomes one local instance of a wider gestational logic in which provision is nurtured inside concealment and then delivered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching and clarification lead into repeated challenges to denial, while later branches describe bringing hidden things out and recognizing by marks. The focus cover can therefore be temporary opacity: fruit concealed now becomes a visible sign later.

activation_trace.role: Visible pleasant produce supplies the disclosed result at the end of maturation.
Covering or suppressing, including testimony, makes the sheath available as an image of delayed evidence.
A thing becoming disclosed to a knower supplies the epistemic endpoint.
Meaning disclosed through speech or a sign supplies the act of making latent content legible.
Favors name the repeated objects whose evidentiary force is being challenged.
Contradiction of truth supplies the resistant response to what has been shown.
Bringing something out of concealment gives the covered-to-visible transition a contextual verb.
Recognition after a trace or mark supplies the reading of an exterior sign.
A visible mark by which something is known completes the movement from hidden content to legible surface.

structural_cues: 55:2-4 moves from teaching to clarification before the material signs of 55:5-12.
The refrain begins immediately after 55:11-12 and repeatedly asks whether supplied favors will be denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, signification, denial, emergence, and recognition; I infer that botanical covering delays rather than cancels evidence, with ripened fruit as the revealed result. The live alternative is that the sheath remains purely agronomic and the refrain comments on it only externally.

changed_reading.before: The sheaths are opaque botanical accessories.
changed_reading.after: The sheaths stage deferred disclosure: a favor can be real while hidden, then ripen into evidence whose denial becomes harder.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation by estimation, balance, assigned placement, sprouting soil, seed, husk, and aromatic leaf turn the focus into one layer of an ordered plant system. The sheath is a timed partition between growing structure and usable yield.

activation_trace.role: The date-palm supplies the stemmed producer within the ordered plant system.
The plant sheath supplies stage-specific protection and separation.
Estimating and measuring a thing supplies design before realized form.
A created thing proportioned in balance makes measure material rather than merely juridical.
Placement in a settled or lower position supplies the earth-side ordering of the system.
Soft sprouting soil supplies the productive substrate.
The seed that sprouts and bears grain supplies generative recurrence.
Grain husk and crumbled crop leaf supply another protective plant layer beside the palm sheath.
Aromatic plant and leaf supply a non-fruit output from the same differentiated ecology.

structural_cues: 55:5-12 moves from calculated heavenly bodies to balance, placed earth, covered palm fruit, grain, husk, and aromatic growth.
The focus's ذات construction makes the protective layer an identifying capacity of the palm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, placement, soil, seed, husk, and leaf; I infer that the sheath operationalizes measure by controlling developmental exposure and release. The live alternative is a rhetorically ordered but mechanically unconnected produce list.

changed_reading.before: The verse names attractive contents of the earth.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes plant architecture under measure: substrate, producer, temporary cover, edible yield, residue, and scent occupy distinct timed roles.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea sequence moves from mixing and meeting through a non-overrun boundary to precious emergence. It activates the focus sheath as an active boundary whose restraint enables rather than prevents valuable output.

activation_trace.role: The plant envelope supplies a permeable developmental boundary around valuable output.
Mixing and disorder supply the contact that requires regulation.
Two opposed things meeting supplies productive contact across a boundary.
Transgressing a limit supplies the destructive alternative that the boundary blocks.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies emergence after bounded formation.
The pearl supplies the precious output produced by the bounded sea system.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 presents meeting, an intervening barrier, non-overreach, and then emergence in that order.
The focus likewise names a valuable output beside a producer defined by enclosing boundaries.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies meeting, limit, non-transgression, concealment, and precious emergence; I infer that managed separation causes productive formation and map that arrow back to the sheath. The live alternative is only a loose analogy between unrelated natural scenes.

changed_reading.before: A sheath merely hides or shields fruit.
changed_reading.after: A sheath becomes a productive boundary: restraint creates the conditions in which a valuable interior can form and emerge intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later judgment and recompense vocabulary carries crop branches for perishability, unripe dates, cutting, harvest residue, ripeness, a date basket, recompense, cutting-time, and selection. These activate the sheathed palm as the pre-harvest phase of a larger maturation, cutting, sorting, and return mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Sifting supplies the post-harvest separation operation latent in the named palm.
Choosing the best supplies the sorting criterion after maturation.
The protective sheath marks the crop's not-yet-ready phase.
Cessation and departure after a period of remaining supply the terminal limit of each growth cycle.
The branch's operation on unripe dates keeps date maturation active inside the accountability sequence.
Cutting and harvest supply the decisive removal that follows ripeness.
Harvest remnants and dried fruit supply the residue left by that separation.
Reaching the proper time or maturity supplies the threshold before cutting.
A date basket supplies the receiving container after fruit leaves its sheath.
Meeting an act with its recompense supplies the return relation governing the later selection.
The non-dominant mapped branch for cutting-time and maturity fuses recompense with harvest timing without collapsing the split mapping.
Seeking the good through choice supplies the final selection among matured outcomes.

structural_cues: The packet moves from universal perishing in 55:26 through recognition and seizure in 55:39-44 to recompense in 55:60.
The later garden sequence restores fruit and palms after the judgment sequence, allowing growth and assessment to remain linked.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crop-processing branch images inside judgment and recompense terms; I infer the directional chain protected growth to ripeness to cutting to sorting to return. The live alternative is that the agricultural branches are independent polysemies and the judgment sequence has no harvest mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sheathed palm is a static token of bounty.
changed_reading.after: It is the opening, protected phase of a harvest logic in which maturation precedes cutting, sorting, and consequential return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later branching variety, paired fruit-kinds, near picking, and the exact return of fruit and palm unfold the compact focus inventory. The unique sheaths in 55:11 mark potential still folded up; later scenes display diversified and accessible yield.

activation_trace.role: The focus sheath supplies the folded developmental state from which later abundance can unfold.
A branching bough supplies visible ramification of the earlier compact potential.
The exact return of pleasant fruit carries the focus yield into the later gardens.
Kinds or varieties multiply the undifferentiated fruit of the focus.
Taking fruit from its place of growth converts enclosed potential into harvestable yield.
Nearness makes the later yield immediately accessible, contrasting with the focus cover.
Repeated fruit confirms that the focus noun is a recurring garden component.
The exact return of the date-palm makes 55:11 a compact precursor rather than an isolated list.
Pomegranate adds named differentiation to the earlier general fruit category.

structural_cues: The locative pattern shifts from فيها in 55:11 to repeated فيهما in 55:50, 55:52, 55:66, and 55:68.
Only the early palm is identified by sheaths; later fruit is paired, near enough to pick, and expanded by a named pomegranate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact noun recurrence, branching, varieties, picking, and nearness; I infer a proleptic compression in which 55:11 holds later garden abundance in an earlier folded state. The live alternative is ordinary thematic repetition with no temporal unfolding.

changed_reading.before: 55:11 is a self-contained description of terrestrial produce.
changed_reading.after: 55:11 remains terrestrial but also becomes a compressed precursor whose covered potential is unfolded as varied, paired, and accessible garden fruit later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing branches join nurture and completion, quality vegetation, a vessel lid, and stable growing good. Retrospectively, the focus palm embodies value not as instant consumption but as growth conserved under cover and renewed through cycles.

activation_trace.role: The perennial date-palm supplies the enduring living carrier of recurring yield.
The sheath supplies conservation of fragile growth until it can continue the cycle.
Nurture and completion supply sustained care across the growth process.
Quality vegetation and rain make honor materially legible as flourishing growth.
A lid over a vessel unexpectedly echoes the focus cover as conservation rather than deprivation.
Stable, growing good supplies the final temporal description of protected fertility.

structural_cues: 55:78 closes the same surah that repeatedly returned to fruit, palms, gardens, water, and protective interiors.
The focus gives the closing abstraction of growing good a concrete botanical mechanism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture, flourishing vegetation, a vessel lid, and stable growing good; I read the closing formula retrospectively through the focus sheath and infer conserved renewal. The live alternative is that 55:78 remains general praise with no botanical return.

changed_reading.before: Fruit is bounty because it can be consumed.
changed_reading.after: Fruit and sheaths are bounty because they display stable good as a renewable process: nurtured, conserved, matured, and renewed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a cosmic rupture onto plant morphology; it remains anchored because أَكْمَام are literal covers and 55:37 supplies splitting, floral redness, and oil. Downstream prose should present it as a cross-scale echo, never as an identification of the sky with a palm sheath.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَكْمَام as covers that must open for palm produce to appear

activation_trace.role: The fruit sheath supplies the small-scale cover whose opening releases formed contents.
Splitting and opening supply the rupture event at cosmic scale.
Flower and saturated red color supply the vivid appearance after opening.
Oil or unguent supplies a material, fruit-like richness to the exposed state.

changed_reading.before: Opening a sheath is an unremarkable botanical transition.
changed_reading.after: Each benign sheath-opening can faintly echo the later terrifying pattern of cover, rupture, color, and released material at another scale.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because reclining, restrained figures, and honor do not surface as vessels or date baskets. It remains valid as an exploratory material pattern because every cited container image is packet-backed and the focus is explicitly anchored in covers; downstream prose should call it a recurring enclosure grammar, not a lexical paraphrase of the later ayat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The palm's أَكْمَام as botanical containers around an interior

activation_trace.role: A worn covering for head or hand lets the botanical sheath participate in a garment-like enclosure image.
The literal plant envelope anchors every later material analogy in the focus.
Tying a vessel's mouth supplies a closable container around contents.
A garment lining makes the protected interior itself an object of value.
A date basket supplies a second container specifically fitted to the palm's released yield.
Tent and settled dwelling enlarge enclosure from fruit-scale to inhabited space.
A hanging or fluttering cover supplies the outer drape of the later protected interior.
A lid over a vessel closes the enclosure pattern at the surah's end.

changed_reading.before: The sheaths are one botanical detail with no wider material role.
changed_reading.after: The sheaths begin an exploratory nested architecture of cover, vessel, lining, date basket, tent, drape, and lid in which abundance is repeatedly housed inside protected interiors.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because speech, muzzling, and testimony are remote from the surface fruit-and-palm syntax. It remains anchored in the focus branches for pleasant talk and covering, and context explicitly supplies sociability, clarification, and denial; downstream prose should preserve it only as a secondary social activation, not translate فَٰكِهَة or أَكْمَام by these branches.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَٰكِهَةٌ as pleasant talk and أَكْمَام as mouth-covering or suppressed testimony

activation_trace.role: Pleasant joking and congenial talk supply a social form of enjoyment inside the focus noun.
A muzzle over an animal's mouth supplies restraint at the organ of expression.
Suppressing or covering testimony supplies the risk that meaningful speech is concealed.
Sociability that removes estrangement supplies the human setting for congenial talk.
Disclosing meaning through speech or sign supplies speech's clarifying function.
Contradiction of truth supplies the failure mode against which expression is tested.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains edible pleasure and botanical coverings only.
changed_reading.after: A secondary reading hears convivial human pleasure held beside the danger of muzzled, suppressed, or truth-denying speech.

strongest_changes: The sheaths became temporal operators: protection now, emergence and harvest later.
Judgment and recompense branches activated a crop-processing chain of ripening, cutting, baskets, sifting, selection, and return.
Exact later returns of fruit and palm unfolded 55:11 as a compressed precursor without canceling its terrestrial reading.
Womb, birth, nurture, and near-parturition branches strengthened a coexisting gestational model of provision.
summary.what_was_special: The three focus roots activated unusually dense but distinct networks around enclosure, disclosure, gestation, productive boundaries, selection, and harvest. The literal fruit, palm, and sheath reading remains live underneath every extension rather than being replaced by a single synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the gestational and harvest chains are inter-ayah mechanisms or productive coincidences of branch polysemy.
Whether the later gardens make 55:11 genuinely proleptic or simply repeat a shared abundance lexicon.
How much weight to give form-distant mappings and branches such as ج ز ي to ج ز ز, و ك ء as a tied vessel, and ق ص ر as a date basket.
